title.narrative: Vietnam International Bank Supporting Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises and Improving Living Conditions Project

description.narrative: A proposed loan of up to $200,000,000 to Vietnam International Commercial Joint Stock Bank (VIB), comprising (i) a senior unsecured A loan of up to $100,000,000; and (ii) a B loan of up to $100,000,000 for the Supporting Small and Medium-sized Enterprises and for Improving Living Conditions project in Viet Nam. The proposed loan to VIB, one of the leading joint stock banks in Viet Nam, will provide critically needed financing to the underserved segment of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
